categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily as the largest third-party on-demand delivery service platform in China, focusing on intra-city delivery services for merchants and consumers, and last-mile delivery mainly for logistics companies. Its business covers multiple scenarios including food delivery, local retail, local e-commerce, and local services, aiming to build infrastructure for the new consumption ecosystem.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI-driven technologies and a proprietary City Logistics System (CLS) for intelligent business planning, rider dispatch, and operational optimization. It integrates AI Foundation Models for user demand analysis, merchant operations, customer service, and delivery scheduling. The company also explores smart logistics and unmanned delivery technologies, operating unmanned vehicle delivery routes to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include merchants (both large chain brands and small-to-medium enterprises) and individual consumers requiring on-demand delivery services. The company serves diverse industries such as food and beverage, retail (including supermarkets, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, maternity and baby products), e-commerce platforms, and logistics service providers. Major customers include subsidiaries of SF Holding and other top-tier clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering more than 2,300 cities and counties nationwide, with a strategic focus on expanding in lower-tier cities and county-level areas. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, and Singapore, supporting international logistics and delivery services.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing third-party intra-city on-demand delivery and last-mile delivery services. It acts as a neutral and open logistics infrastructure platform connecting merchants, consumers, and logistics companies, facilitating order fulfillment and delivery within urban areas.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include high-quality, sustainable growth with a focus on multi-scenario service coverage and technological innovation. R&D efforts emphasize AI integration, digital operations, intelligent scheduling, and unmanned delivery technologies. The company also invests in expanding service coverage, rider welfare, and operational efficiency through lean management and AI-driven decision-making.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through service fees charged for intra-city on-demand delivery and last-mile delivery services. Fees are based on order volume, delivery distance, service timeliness, and customer type (merchants or consumers). The company also earns revenue from strategic partnerships and provides customized delivery solutions to key account customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as the leading third-party on-demand delivery platform in China by order volume, competing with other delivery service providers in the intra-city and last-mile logistics sectors. It differentiates itself through a neutral and open platform, extensive multi-scenario coverage, advanced technology adoption, and strong partnerships with major traffic platforms and merchants.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of RMB 15.75 billion, a 27.1% increase year-on-year, with net profit doubling to RMB 132.5 million. It has shown consistent growth in gross profit margin (6.8% in 2024) and maintains a healthy cash flow and financial reserves. The company employs over 2,000 full-time employees and has approximately 1 million active riders and over 23 million active consumers.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, efficient, and comprehensive delivery services with a focus on customer satisfaction and operational excellence. Its value proposition includes a flexible and elastic delivery network, AI-powered intelligent dispatch and scheduling, multi-scenario service capabilities, and a rider-friendly platform with strong welfare and safety measures. It aims to be the preferred delivery partner for urgent, high-value, and time-sensitive deliveries.
